baselineSource: Actual Unity helmet snapshot recorded 2026-10-31, build188 character integration. Source retained verbatim.

variants.live: Actual Unity-produced saved run, portrait, skills and history. Only phoneInBackground false for foreground presentation.
variants.away: Controlled eight-column trajectory for gained counters, reap/restart pause and expiry. Not an observed forecast.
variants.restart: Same controlled trajectory, sampled at 110s restart.
variants.stale: Same controlled trajectory, sampled at 7200s expired.
variants.offline: Same controlled trajectory, sampled at 15s cached offline.
variants.no-reap: Controlled distance reaping disabled; no distance cap or percent may appear.
variants.large: Controlled large values and low health, real source shape.
variants.town: Controlled town state; retained skills/history remain available.
variants.history: CONTROLLED varied retained global ten for trends/comparison/dossier, not real player history. Same-map records include estimated and recorded outcomes.
variants.no-history: Controlled no retained history; current River map known, no invented best/rate.
variants.beyond-history: Controlled current Mines distance 5200 beyond recent best2550, actual effective cap38000. Does not assert managed estimator behavior.

clock: Frozen source generatedAt +15 seconds; away +85; restart +110; stale +7200. Animation clock only is real time. Empty uses nil.
